**Job Description**
We have an exciting and rewarding opportunity for you to take your software engineering career to the next level.
  
  
As a Software Engineer III at JPMorganChase within the Business Banking, Business Access and Tools division, you serve as a seasoned member of an agile team to design and deliver trusted market-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. You are responsible for carrying out critical technology solutions across multiple technical areas within various business functions in support of the firm's business objectives.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Executes software solutions, design, development, and technical troubleshooting with ability to think beyond routine or conventional approaches to build solutions or breakdown technical problems
* Design, develop, and maintain backend services, agentic workflows using TypeScript and APIs using Java, and Spring Boot
* Implement micro-services architecture leveraging Spring Cloud for service discovery, configuration, and resilience
* Containerize and deploy applications on AWS using services such as ECS, EKS, Lambda, or EC2.
* Implement and maintain AWS infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
* Implements reactive programming paradigms for high-performance systems
* Apply 12-factor app principles and best practices for cloud-native development
* Design and execute performance and load tests using JMeter or Blazemeter

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 3+ years applied experience
* Hands-on experience in system design, application development, testing, and operational stability in production environments.
* Backend experience with Java 21, Spring Boot, and Spring Cloud; building microservices with service discovery, configuration, and resiliency patterns.
* Front-end experience with TypeScript and JavaScript, delivering end-to-end functionality across UI and APIs.
* AWS cloud and infrastructure experience using Infrastructure as Code (IaC), including Lambda, S3, and Kafka-based integrations.
* Experience applying reactive programming paradigms for high-performance, resilient systems.
* Strong cloud-native engineering practices, including applying 12-factor app principles.
* Performance and load testing experience using JMeter or BlazeMeter, with results-driven tuning and optimization.
* CI/CD pipeline and release automation experience with tools such as Jules and Spinnaker.
* Observability and operational troubleshooting experience using Splunk and Dynatrace.
* Data layer experience across Cassandra, DynamoDB, PostgreSQL, and caching solutions such as ElastiCache, plus familiarity with enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development tools and responsible AI usage in engineering workflows.

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Experience designing and integrating agent-to-UI interactions, including familiarity with agent-to-agent (A2A) protocols.
* Proven ability to troubleshoot, debug, and resolve issues in distributed, multi-agent environments.
* Proficiency in Python for building, automating, and supporting production-grade services and tooling.
